clientSettings.remember_collapsed_tabs: Restores collapsed drawer groups and settings sections the next time this screen opens. Turning it off leaves the saved state untouched and starts every group expanded.
clientSettings.instant_discard_all: Discard deletes the whole selected row in one click. Off by default because discarding is irreversible; with it off, Discard opens the quantity prompt the way Sell does.
clientSettings.show_jei_overlay: Leaves JEI a band along the bottom of the Inventory and Crafting screen. With it off, the screen claims the whole viewport and JEI finds no room.
clientSettings.soul_link_visibility: Locked Soul Links are hidden by default, so the tab shows what you actually have.

serverSettings.quest_auto_accept: Applies only to Daily, Common, and Chunk quests. Side and Challenge quests always require manual acceptance. Turning this off does not cancel active quests; newly generated quests remain Available.
